1.text: “My picture will never look right,” Kiyah whispered. Every time she started to draw, the flowers swayed and the butterflies flew away.

2.text: Chike noticed her frown. “What are you creating today?” he asked. “I am trying to draw the garden,” Kiyah said, “but everything keeps moving.”

3.text: “Maybe the garden is giving you clues,” Chike said, holding up his magnifying glass. “Let’s look really, really close.”

4.text: They looked closely together: yellow pollen on a bee, tiny holes in a leaf, a spider web shining like silver. Kiyah drew one clue at a time.

5.text: By evening her page held a bee, a leaf, a ladybug, a web, and bright flowers: the garden she had discovered up close.

7.text: What Kiyah learned “I thought I needed to make it perfect,” Kiyah said. “I just needed to pay attention.”

8.text: The End What will you create next?
